about.title: About
about.content:
QBTranslator is a local Windows application that translates selected text and screen regions.

Usage: Select text in any application and press the global shortcut. The result opens next to the cursor.

OCR: Select a screen region to translate text in an image.

Privacy: Translated text is sent only to the selected engine. History and words remain on this computer.
